Case B: The manager proposes using three interns and no certified technicians as the three qualifying personnel for the vaccination-service exception.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The stated vaccination-service pathway permits up to six support personnel when its conditions are met.
A promised future certification may count toward today's qualifying group.
The one-to-six pathway removes all separate intern-supervision limits.
Three interns with no certified technicians satisfy the required three-person qualifying group.

choice_analysis.A: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 1:6은 vaccination-service 조건부 경로다.
choice_analysis.B:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 미래 자격취득 계획은 현재 ratio 요건을 충족하지 않는다.

choice_analysis.C:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. staffing ratio와 intern supervision 제한은 각각 확인한다.
교정된 설명: Separate intern-supervision restrictions still need to be checked.
choice_analysis.D:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. qualifying group에는 interns 최대 두 명이라는 경계가 있다.
